text:
maria: bringup note: ran reranker-v3 on our standard holdout. weird split: overall NDCG@10 +2.3% but MRR@10 -4.5%. tail_queries slice is tanking.
alex: which candidate set did you use? any curation changes recently?
maria: yes 10 we switched to the new fuzzy-title deduper in the preproc (replaces embedding-cluster dedupe). config: `dedupe.strategy=fuzzy_title` and `dedupe.threshold=0.85`.
sam: did you test fp32 vs quant? what backend/recipe?
maria: runs:+ fp32 baseline, int8 PTQ (per-channel) and int4 AQT for the new smaller footprint. int8 shows ndcg +1.1 mrr -1.2, int4 shows ndcg +2.3 mrr -4.5.
jin: that pattern smells like tie-breaking variance. fuzzy dedupe changes which near-duplicates remain in the candidate pool; quantized scorer compresses logits so small scoring differences vanish and are resolved by non-deterministic ordering.
alex: i pulled a sample case: qid=Q9832 short tail query. before dedupe (embed) top candidates: [D1, D2, D3] after fuzzy dedupe top: [D2, D5, D1]. rerank scores (fp32) favoured D1, but int4 compressed D1/D2 gap -> tiebreak picks D2 which is lower gold rank.
sam: can you paste the eval command, and the small reproduce snippet?
maria: ```
./eval_rerank --gold holdout_tail.json --pred preds_v3.json --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 --slices tail_queries,core_queries --dedupe-config dedupe.yaml --quant int4_aqt
```

reproduce snippet I used: ```bash
python tools/repro_tail.py --qids tailsample_200.json --model rerank-v3-int4 --candidates s3://redwood/cands/v3/fuzzy_0.85.json
```

maria: reran with `dedupe.strategy=embed_cluster` and int4 -> ndcg +1.0, mrr -0.6 (much smaller). so root cause is candidate curation + quant compression.
jin: mitigation ideas: 1) add deterministic tie-breaker in the reranker by doc_id hash, 2) record candidate curation checksum as part of onboarding, 3) add a short tail-slice CI smoke that runs int4 vs fp32 diffs on ~250 queries.
alex: for 1) we can apply tiny deterministic bias: score += (doc_id_hash % 1000) * 1e-6 pre-softmax so it doesn't change fp32 ordering meaningfully but stabilizes ties in quantized runs. can prototype in rerank-serving.
sam: for 2) gating: onboarding checklist should require candidate-curation parity (dedupe strategy and threshold), preproc checksum, and quantization sensitivity note in the model card.
maria: i'll open PRs: one to revert fuzzy dedupe for the next canary, one to add the tiny bias patch, and one to the onboarding checklist with CI smoke. uploading artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/artifacts/rerank/v3/1712288888/
deploy-bot: staging snapshot created: snapshot-2026-03-10-22-05 :rocket:
alex: quick experiment results attached in the PR: plot_ndcg_mrr_tail.png and examples_failed_ids.txt.
jin: add an assert in the eval harness that candidate-curation checksum matches the golden used during offline evals. that would have flagged this.
sam: agree. also add a note for quantization: "candidate set composition amplifies score compression effects; validate tail-slices under target quant regimes" in the model onboarding docs.
maria: follow-ups: PRs for dedupe revert, bias patch, onboarding checklist + CI smoke, model card update, and upload of example diffs. I'll tag reviewers.
alex: thanks all 10 helps prevent a bad canary.
